lesson: Always modify existing open files IN PLACE - never create new files unless explicitly required
Use python-docx library for in-place modifications of Word documents
Perform COMPLETE OVERWRITES, not appends - replace all content/paragraphs
Check screenshot context to identify which file is currently open before modifying
NEVER modify headers, titles, or structural elements unless explicitly requested by the user
Maintain fonts, colors, formatting, and styles when modifying document content
Only change content/data, not visual presentation or structure
